versions.content: Existence of VariableInAtomicSWCTypeInstanceRef . rootVariableDataPrototype in the context of NvBlockDataMapping . nvRam- BlockElement In the context of NvBlockDataMapping . nvRamBlockElement , the reference in the VariableInAtomicSWCTypeInstanceRef . rootVariable- DataPrototype is redundant because the information carried by this reference is already conveyed by the aggregation NvBlockDescriptor . ramBlock . Therefore, VariableInAtomicSWCTypeInstanceRef . rootVariableDataPro- totype shall be ignored in the context of NvBlockDataMapping . nvRamBlockEle- ment .
